purpose: Cross-parent stability of an unchanged target-adaptive executable program versus copying fixed seed47 edits; historically seen task data, not a heldout generalization study.

qualification_per_parent.artifact: Full SHA, exact canonical tensor/alias map, source and original train-only normalizer binding, same allowed40 scope; malformed source -> parent-specific qualification failure, never substitute another parent.
qualification_per_parent.existing_native_receipts: Reuse existing frozen canonical12-case core qualification only for its actual pinned source. No new native forward is hidden as a qualification step.
qualification_per_parent.gradient: Fixed first2 train queries, full6tick F32 scores/F64 CE, Rademacher40 seed20261127, h2^-8, baseline/plus/minus3 forwards and baseline1 backward.
qualification_per_parent.criterion: All40 gradients finite and nonzero norm; abs((Lplus-Lminus)-grad0 dot(actual_theta_plus-actual_theta_minus)) <=1e-5+.1*max(abs(actual finite difference),abs(dot)). No epsilon/tolerance tuning.
qualification_per_parent.failure: Stop that parent's optimization and report QUALIFICATION_FAILED; it remains in every planned denominator. No rerun or replacement parent.

arms.name: KEEP
arms.source: Each parent's own newly budgeted train baseline and dev+eligible retain output.

arms.name: RERUN_PROGRAM
arms.source: Run the same code unchanged on this parent's own train trace; own correct masks, own boundary prototypes, original theta/reset. No LLM calls.

arms.name: COPY_SOURCE_DELTA
arms.source: For each source dose independently, subtract actual seed47 old/new F32 values as exact dyadic differences. Add that same vector to this parent's original40 parameters, cast to F32 and apply the same inward-only exact-norm gate. Do not apply the dose twice; do not remeasure target activations to choose values.

arms.name: BP_TASK
arms.source: Independent same-parent16-step task-gradient baseline with identical allowed40, exact F32 radius, train labels and2 candidate checks.

bp.objective: F64 binary CE from actual F32 two-choice output + .25 mean squared parent-margin deviation on parent-correct training rows; same declared objective as original pilot.
bp.sampling: Two fixed seed20261127 permutations of train80; first10 batches from first, next6 from second.

candidate_policy.selection: Within each method only the same predeclared dev-correct, dev-Brier, realized-displacement order; include KEEP; KEEP wins exact tie.
candidate_policy.protection: Per-parent baseline eligible retain correct-to-wrong<=0, Brier increase<=.01; physical violations<=2e-9; all finite.
candidate_policy.signal: At least1 new dev correct and train CE strictly lower. Descriptive developmental evidence only.
candidate_policy.unavailable: A method that cannot produce a required candidate records ABSTAIN/UNAVAILABLE, retains slot in planned denominator, and consumes no substitute candidate. If seed47 failed to compile a dose, COPY for that dose is unavailable on BOTH fixed parents; RERUN/BP still follow their predeclared own-parent qualification. If source47 is poor on dev but structurally admissible, its deltas are still copied.

budget_derivation_per_parent.stage: RERUN2+COPY2+BP2 frozen candidates, each train80 and devretain60

incremental_budget_max.nonzero_candidate_slots_semantics: Evaluated F32 candidate slots; excludes unused real-valued wrong-role/random directions whose construction is nevertheless costed.

accounting.cold_cost: Include each parent's own baseline trace, correct-mask supervision, prototype extraction, inverse roots, real solver, F32 realization, all checks, failures and original source program discovery/preparation where measured.
accounting.reuse_cost: Incremental transfer reuses program code and source deltas, not target activations or labels. Publish both cold and incremental cost.
accounting.llm_discovery_cost: No new editor call on rerun; research-conversation planning cost is not measured and must not be called zero.
accounting.partial_exhaustion: Report started operations, completed operations, all failures, remaining budget. No relaunch under new ID after uncertain execution.
accounting.source_identity: Every parent/candidate/data trace/full output bound by complete file SHA and original source/normalizer hashes. Candidate evaluation always uses actual candidate bytes and full raw-input6tick model.

required_before_execution: Root reviews root isolation/pure qualification and source program
Root approves exact execution owner/resources and separate ledger
All comparator implementations presealed; no output-conditioned edits
